jobs.description:
Do you have a strategic and commercial mindset and do you have experience in portfolio optimization and marketing management of Consumer Healthcare brands? Then you might be our new Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager

About the job

As our Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager, Consumer Healthcare you will have two main objectives: 1) Maintain a healthy, commercially relevant and optimized Consumer Healthcare Portfolio across categories and markets, and 2) Drive and own one of our global Consumer Healthcare categories across markets in accordance with the business objectives and the commercial strategy.

The role ensures strong day-to-day portfolio management across categories and markets. This requires strong analytical skills and a solid commercial understanding combined with an ability to ensure stakeholder management along the value chain. Furthermore, the role ensures category ownership of a specified global Consumer Healthcare category (e.g., Allergy) which includes maintenance and development of the category through marketing initiatives, launch of new products, best-practice sharing across markets as well as continuous performance follow-ups.

Your key responsibilities:

• Define and drive yearly cross-country strategy plan for the given Consumer Healthcare category

• Ensure cross-country marketing initiatives and best-practice sharing to support the growth journey

• Further build the product pipeline in close collaboration with the Business Development team

• Portfolio analysis across the full Consumer Healthcare portfolio to identify optimization opportunities in accordance with the commercial strategy

• Owning and driving pruning processes in collaboration the global- and local marketing teams

• P&L responsibility for the given Consumer Healthcare category

• Manage advertising & promotion budget securing investment in projects that drive the best ROI

• Manage relationships with stakeholders across the value chain, local marketing teams as well as external stakeholders such as creative agencies

In this role you will report to Director, Global Marketing, Malene Reimers. Please note that this position is a parental cover lasting 12 months, but we expect to extend the position following the maternity cover to support our growth journey.

Who are you?

The ideal candidate brings a relevant educational background and minimum 5 years of experience from a somewhat similar position within an international consumer-focused organization, preferably in the Consumer Healthcare sector.

We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical skills, solid commercial understanding and great communication skills. You have a structured and well-organized approach and can manage complex projects effectively, while your analytical competencies enable data-driven decision-making and clear recommendations.

As a professional, you work independently and have successfully managed product portfolios and led brands or categories. Additionally, you have exceptional stakeholder management skills and experience working in a matrix organization as this role requires collaboration across diverse teams and functions.

Lastly, you must be an empathetic team player with good interpersonal skills.

Who are we?

The position sits within the Global Marketing team, and you will report to the Global Marketing Director, Consumer Healthcare. We are a small professional, and ambitious team which includes senior marketing professionals. Our culture is characterized by openness, a strong can-do-attitude and great team spirit.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Job location

The position can be located at our headquarters in Odense or office in Søborg.

Join Dustin as an Account Manager and take full ownership of your customer portfolio, driving growth and long-term partnerships in the Mid Market segment. This opportunity is open in both Brøndby and Aarhus, offering a flexible setup within a supportive, high-performing team where collaboration, autonomy, and development go hand in hand.

**This is what makes the position as Account Manager unique

**

• 
Own the full sales cycle with high autonomy and directly influence both customer success and revenue growth in the Mid Market segment

• 
Work in a collaborative, knowledge-sharing team where support, development, and celebrating wins together are part of everyday life

• 
Partner with leading IT vendors like Lenovo, HP, and Dell while managing your own customer portfolio and driving strategic account growth

My name is Anders Stensgaard. I am the Sales Manager for Mid Market Enterprises in Denmark. As a leader, I am strategic and empowering, and I’m dedicated to creating a high-performance environment where trust, accountability, and teamwork help you grow, succeed, and achieve great results together.

**Your role & influence as Account Manager

**Responsibility: You will be given responsibility for driving revenue and profitability by managing and growing your customer portfolio, delivering strategic sales, and optimizing sales processes in close collaboration with your team and key vendors

Collaboration: Together with your team, you take care of driving revenue and earnings for your customer portfolio. You'll work closely not only with your immediate team members but also with departments such as finance and procurement.

Core activities:

• 
Manage and develop your customer portfolio, driving the full sales cycle from opportunity to successful deal closure

• 
Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to secure competitive pricing, handle deal registrations, and deliver strong customer solutions

• 
Proactively engage customers through targeted outreach and value-driven communication to identify new opportunities and grow business

**Benefits Of Joining Dustin

**We believe there's more to Dustin than just the benefits listed here. You'll fully understand this once you're with us. Curious? Our Life at Dustin page has you covered.

• 
A quarterly bonus paid upon achieving your targets.

**You can find more of our benefits below in the vacancy.

****This Is What We Imagine You Bring

**We envision you as a curious and driven individual who thrives in building strong customer relationships and driving value through strategic sales and account development.

_Additionally, it's important that:

_

• 
You have a bachelor's degree level of working and thinking

• 
Experience with B2B sales and account management, ideally within IT and Mid Market environments

• 
Technical skills including a solid understanding of IT products, hardware, software, and services, as well as experience working with CRM systems such as Dynamics 365

• 
You're available for full-time employment (40 hours per week)

• 
You are proficient in both Danish and English

**What can you expect next?

**To ensure a fair recruitment process free from unconscious bias, we handle your application anonymously and do not accept cover letters. Please refrain from sending one, so that the selection is based solely on professional competencies. We expect the following steps in the recruitment process:

• 
Telephone screening

• 
1st interview with Anders Stensgaard

• 
Assessment (Personality- and cognitive thinking test)

• 
2nd interview with Anders Stensgaard and someone from the team

**Strategic Sourcing Manager to drive Category Management at RTX A/S

**_Would you like to help shape the future of Strategic Sourcing in a global technology company? At RTX, we are strengthening our Category Management approach and are looking for a Strategic Sourcing Manager who can combine analytical insight, commercial judgement and technical curiosity to create measurable value across our supply base.

_**About RTX

**RTX is a global technology company that designs, develops and manufactures advanced wireless communication solutions for customers within Enterprise, Healthcare and Professional Audio.

Headquartered in Nørresundby, Denmark, RTX employs more than 300 people across Denmark, Hong Kong, Romania and the US. We work closely with global technology brands, delivering customized solutions from concept and development through production and full product lifecycle management.

Our combination of deep technical expertise, global partnerships and in-house development capabilities enables us to turn complex wireless technologies into reliable solutions that create value for our customers and their end users.

**What We Offer

**Strategic Sourcing at RTX is entering a new phase. We are moving from a more project-oriented sourcing setup to a structured Category Management approach, and you will play an important role in that development.

You will join a small and experienced Global Sourcing team with significant influence on priorities, methods and sourcing strategies. Working closely with Engineering, R&D and Operations, you will have the opportunity to shape how RTX works with categories, suppliers, cost optimization and supply resilience going forward.

You will report to the Director, Global Sourcing and be based at our headquarters in Nørresundby.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will be responsible for selected sourcing categories and develop strategies based on spend analysis, market insight, supplier performance and business requirements. A central part of the role is to identify opportunities across products and projects and translate them into sourcing initiatives that improve cost, competitiveness and supply security.

You will work closely with technical stakeholders when evaluating components, alternative solutions and second-source opportunities, while also strengthening RTX’s commercial position towards suppliers and EMS partners. Your key responsibilities include:

• Develop and implement category strategies based on spending, market and supplier analysis.

• Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities through bundling, standardization and supplier consolidation.

• Develop second-source and dual-source solutions to reduce supply risk.

• Work with Engineering and R&D on alternative components and technical specifications.

• Build market and supplier intelligence to support sourcing decisions and negotiations.

• Negotiate strategic prices, contracts and commercial terms.

• Strengthening collaboration with EMS partners and contribute to the development of a more focused partner setup.

• Support initiatives that improve long-term delivery performance and supply resilience.

**Your Qualifications

**We are looking for a sourcing professional with strong analytical capabilities, commercial understanding and an interest in technology.

You may already have solid experience within Category Management and Strategic Sourcing, or you may come from an electronics or manufacturing environment where you have worked strategically with suppliers and components. The exact combination is less important than your ability to understand the business, challenge existing solutions and drive initiatives over time. We expect you to:

• Have experience in Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, procurement or supplier management.

• Be confident working with spend analysis, market data and sourcing strategies.

• Have experience from a manufacturing or technology-driven environment, preferably involving electronics, components or EMS partners.

• Understand the interaction between sourcing, Engineering and R&D.

• Have strong negotiation skills and experience with contracts, suppliers and cost optimization.

• Be analytical, structured and able to turn complex information into clear recommendations.

• Be persistent and comfortable driving initiatives that require alignment across several stakeholders.

• Communicate professionally in English and Danish in an international environment.

A relevant degree within Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering or a related field is an advantage, but practical experience, mindset and your ability to create results are equally important.

**Application and Contact Information

**Guldbrandsen & Lythje is handling the recruitment process. If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Partner Dan Lythje at +45 93 84 84 49 or Partner Lise Guldbrandsen at +45 20 67 67 57. Applications should be sent to: Strategic Sourcing Manager to drive Category Management at RTX A/S - Guldbrandsen & Lythje ApS

We invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. You can apply for the position via the link to the right of the advertisement.

jobs.occupation: Student assistant - ideation and early innovation in R&D at Coloplast
jobs.description:
Curious about how problems, user needs, and ideas turn into real solutions? Interested in hands-on experience with innovation in a global MedTech company – and helping shape what we work on next? Then this is your chance to join our R&D Scoping team as a student assistant.

We are strengthening our innovation funnel to ensure a focused, high-quality, and strategically aligned pipeline. As part of this, you will support idea management – helping capture, structure, and move forward the right ideas at the right time.

About the R&D Scoping team

We are an early-stage R&D team dedicated to exploring, shaping, and testing the future of Coloplast.

We work with ideas, concepts, and new solution spaces – turning them into structured opportunities for product development. Our team brings together backgrounds in design, strategy, business, and engineering – a mix of thinkers, doers, and prototype builders.

As our student assistant, you will:

•   Gain hands-on insight into how early-stage innovation works in practice

•   Help turn ideas into tangible concepts

•   Co-manage our ideation platform

•   Support rapid testing and learning

Your daily responsibilities:

You will help ensure that ideas flow smoothly through the innovation process and support the day-to-day work in the Scoping team. This includes:

•   Maintaining our ideation platform (NOSCO) – setting up and managing idea channels, campaigns, and scoping flows

•   Supporting colleagues in using the platform – onboarding, guidance, and troubleshooting

•   Helping plan and run idea campaigns end-to-end – from mobilization and ideation to screening, development, and pitching

•   Contributing to continuous improvement – refining processes, templates, and ways of working

•   Supporting the team broadly with research, analysis, coordination, and ad hoc tasks across projects

Expected qualifications

•   Currently studying within a relevant field (e.g. business, innovation, engineering, or similar)

•   Well-structured with the ability to handle multiple tasks and collaborate with different stakeholders

•   Comfortable working with digital tools and platforms; experience with ideation management or innovation collaboration tools is a plus

•   Interest in innovation, idea development processes, and early-stage product work

•   Strong communication skills and a helpful, service-oriented mindset

Language skills:

•   Fluent written and spoken English

•   Danish is not required

Practical information:

The position is based on-site at Coloplast HQ in Humlebæk, North Zealand, Denmark.

Expected workload is approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams.

Interested?

We are looking to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible and will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Solvexis Consult is looking for experienced Electrical Holdledere for work at an Energinet facility in Denmark.

You will lead and supervise electrical work in an assigned area, either within the control building or in outdoor high-voltage areas. Where work takes place concurrently in separate areas, multiple Holdledere may be required.

Candidates must meet Energinet’s training, competence and approval requirements before undertaking the role.

Responsibilities

• 
Lead and supervise the electrical work team at the assigned worksite.

• 
Ensure work follows approved instructions, risk assessments and Energinet safety requirements.

• 
Brief the work team and confirm that responsibilities, hazards and safety measures are understood.

• 
Coordinate with the Arbejdsleder, Koblingsleder, Energinet representatives and contractors.

• 
Confirm that required clearances and electrical safety measures are in place before work begins.

• 
Stop work if conditions change or safety requirements cannot be maintained.

• 
Ensure safe completion and handback of the worksite.

• 
Report deviations, unsafe conditions and incidents.

Qualifications

We expect that you have:

• 
A relevant qualification, such as utility operator, electrician, electrical installer, marine engineer, electrical power engineer or similar.

• 
Experience with high-voltage installations, substations or comparable electrical infrastructure.

• 
Previous experience as a Holdleder, Arbejdsleder or electrical supervisor.

• 
Knowledge of BEK nr. 1608 and DS/EN 50110-1.

• 
Experience with electrical isolation, LOTO, earthing and safe working procedures.

• 
Sufficient Danish to complete Energinet’s mandatory Danish-language Work Supervisor/Team Leader course.

• 
Professional working proficiency in English.

• 
The qualifications and documented practical training required under Energinet’s NDI-020, including the applicable supervised training period.

Previous Energinet training or approval as Holdleder will be a significant advantage.

What we offer

Solvexis provides structured onboarding, administrative support and regular follow-up throughout the assignment.

Employment terms will be agreed based on your qualifications, experience and the conditions of the assignment.

Application

Please apply through our recruitment portal and upload your CV in English.

Your CV should clearly document your:

• 
Electrical qualifications.

• 
High-voltage and substation experience.

• 
Previous Holdleder or supervisory roles.

• 
Energinet training, approvals and supervised practical training.

Applications will be reviewed continuously.

Do you want to gain experience working in the intersection between product engineering, product support and communication of product applications? Are you interested in working with modern technologies across hardware, connectivity, and software? Are you looking to start your career in an innovative green tech company where you can make a real impact?

Here is what the job entails

As our Intern in Technical Product Management, you will support our product managers in product lifecycle management. You will be working hands-on with the development of new products as well as gaining experience in documentation and customer support.

More specifically you will be:

• Maintaining and supporting product hardware and connectivity

• Managing the product lifecycle from launch to optimization and maintenance

• Delivering technical support and analysis of technical issues

• Creating and maintaining technical documentation

In this role, you will work end-to-end with product development while gaining experience in technical product management. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of your own projects based on your interests and career goals, working closely with experienced colleagues who will support your development throughout the internship.

Meet your future team

With a direct reference to the Senior Manager in Technical Product Management, you will become a part of our Technical Product Management-team in the Water department consisting of 10 passionate and skilled colleagues. Together, we combine technical expertise with cross-organizational collaboration to ensure our meters, communication infrastructure, and software meet market demands and quality standards while balancing technical demands with commercial goals. In the team we foster a supportive and collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and sparring are highly encouraged.

Did you know? Collaboration is the backbone of our culture - but it is cake and coffee that fuels our journey to success!

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a curious student who is motivated to operate at the intersection of product technology, customer needs, and the creation of business value. You approach your work with a proactive and structured mindset, while maintaining a strong focus on quality.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are currently studying a degree in Global Business Engineering, Business Development Engineering, or another related field with focus on engineering/digitalization

• Like challenging the status quo and bring new ideas to the table

• Thrive in a collaborative environment interacting with colleagues across the organization

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Details about the internship will be agreed upon individually. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup Head Quarter is in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Technical Product Management - Water, Kirsten Sahl, on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00.

Company: Octarine Bio

Job Type: Full-time / Part-time

Location: Hybrid

Department: Commercial / Sales

Reports to: SVP Commercial Development

About Octarine Bio

Octarine Bio is a Copenhagen-based company pioneering a new generation of sustainable, bio-based colourants. We engineer nature-inspired colours that deliver the performance, stability, and safety profile required for demanding industrial applications while decoupling colour from fossil-based chemistry. PurePalette™ is supplied as a formulated product, ready to use in textiles, plastics, paper, and more.

Designed for drop-in integration and targeting price parity with conventional colourants, PurePalette™ lets customers adopt a more sustainable solution without compromising cost, quality, or scalability.

The Role

As a Technical Sales Manager, you will own the commercial relationships that take PurePalette™ from sample to qualified supply. You will identify and develop new customers across multiple regions and application segments. You will guide customers through the full sales process, from the technical evaluation that industrial colourants require — sampling, trials, and qualification on their own equipment — to supply agreement execution.

This is a hands-on role in a company at an early commercial stage. You will work closely with technical and commercial teams to understand customer needs and bring learnings in the field into product selection and development. As volumes grow, you will also help build the order fulfilment and logistics processes that reliable supply depends on.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable holding technical conversations with engineers and commercial conversations with purchasing managers, and who is motivated by building something new.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify, qualify, and develop new customers & key accounts across target markets and regions

• Manage sample and trial programmes from first request through to qualification on customer equipment

• Present PurePalette™ to technical and commercial audiences, from process engineers to purchasing and sustainability teams

• Understand customer applications and requirements, and work with R&D and application scientists to match them to the right formulation

• Prepare quotations and proposals, and negotiate supply agreements

• Build and maintain relationships with customers, distributors, and partners

• Maintain accurate opportunity and account information in the CRM

• Represent Octarine Bio at trade shows and industry events, and feed market and competitor intelligence back to the business

• Deliver on revenue and growth targets, and help shape our commercial strategy

Qualifications & Experience

Required

• 5+ years in technical sales, business development, or application support in an industrial B2B setting

• Strong ability to deliver a technical sales presentation, to hold a credible technical conversation and to translate it into a commercial one

• Willingness to travel for customer visits and trade shows

• Professional fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

• Curious, proactive, well organized, and comfortable owning a sales pipeline

Preferred

• Experience in colourants, pigments, dyes, inks, coatings, or textile chemicals

• Familiarity with how industrial customers qualify a new raw material — sampling, trials, and regulatory or restricted substance screening

• Experience selling a novel or sustainability-positioned product into cost-sensitive markets

• Working knowledge of the operational side of sales, e.g., order fulfillment, warehousing, shipping, and export documentation

Why work with us

Octarine Bio is located in central Copenhagen – one of Europe’s most liveable cities – in a country world-renowned for its exceptional quality of life and work-life balance. As a biosolutions scale-up, our team members have a high degree of autonomy, and their decisions and daily work have a direct, measurable impact on the company’s success. We offer a competitive salary and an international, collaborative working environment.

How to apply

Please submit to stephanie@octarinebio.com your CV along with a short cover letter explaining your relevant technical and commercial experience and why you would like to join Octarine Bio.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

About Us: Knowledge Gate Group is dedicated to accelerating scientific research by using cutting-edge artificial intelligence to streamline manual processes in the scientific industry. The organization focuses on rapidly connecting research teams with leading global experts, helping close critical knowledge gaps in science. By enabling faster access to expertise, Knowledge Gate Group supports life-saving research and more informed strategic decision-making. The team is passionate about empowering researchers and organizations to test assumptions and make well-qualified decisions with speed and confidence.

Role Description: We're looking for a proactive, relationship-driven Account Manager to help us build something new. You will be responsible for building your own pipeline from scratch, winning new business, and growing accounts over time. This role is a mix of hunting and relationship management, but it starts with hunting.

Your main focus will be building out our client-base within life science and pharmaceuticals, both directly with pharma companies and via market research and consultancy firms. That means a big part of your day-to-day will be outbound prospecting, and getting meetings on the calendar, as well as taking meetings booked by SDRs. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love building relationships, earning commission and get energy from creating opportunities where none existed before, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Own the full sales cycle from first outreach to close, and then account growth

• 
Build and manage your pipeline from scratch through cold calling, outbound outreach, and consistent follow-up, working closely with SDRs where relevant to close new opportunities

• 
Act as the main point of contact for clients and active opportunities, ensuring a smooth and high-quality experience

• 
Collaborate closely with the fulfillment team to ensure timely and successful delivery of solutions

• 
Identify opportunities for upselling KGG’s services and expanding our footprint within client organizations

• 
Develop a deep understanding of client goals and challenges to offer tailored support and strategic insights

• 
Track pipeline and account activity, gather feedback, and ensure retention through strong service and communication

• 
Prepare and deliver reports, presentations, and proposals as needed to support client success and internal alignment

What We’re Looking For:

• 
3+ years of experience in sales, account management, or client success, preferably in knowledge services, professional services, or within pharma/life sciences

• 
A builder mindset. You like starting from zero, creating momentum, and owning your number

• 
Comfortable doing outbound every day, including cold calling, and staying consistent even when it takes time to break through

• 
Strategic thinker with a client-first mindset and a drive to grow business relationships

• 
Extremely organized and detail-oriented. You keep things moving, nothing slips through the cracks, and your inbox is always under control

• 
Highly responsive and proactive. You don’t wait to be asked, and you never leave a client waiting

• 
A strong communicator, both written and verbal, comfortable engaging with clients across different time zones, cultures, and seniority levels

Why Join KGG?

• 
Accelerated career growth. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact. You won’t be stepping into an existing playbook. You’ll help build the pipeline and get real credit for the results

• 
A dynamic and engaging environment with a diverse international team

• 
Opportunity to make your mark in a fast-evolving company at the forefront of decentralized science

• 
Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives

• 
Flexible work environment and support for professional development

MagVenture is a pioneering Danish MedTech company and global leader in magnetic stimulation therapy. Through FDA approvals and extensive scientific research, our Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) technology is transforming the treatment of complex conditions such as depression, OCD, and PTSD.

As a company, we are on a rapid international growth journey with many exciting new products to come and now we need another IT Student Assistant.

Our IT department consists of a team of three: two IT specialists and one student assistant. The department is responsible for supporting and maintaining the company's IT infrastructure, end-user devices, and hardware across the organization. The team provides technical support to colleagues while continuously improving our IT environment to ensure security, scalability, and high availability. In addition, IT plays a key role in implementing new technologies and supporting the business with reliable and efficient digital solutions.

The position reports to our CTO and is for up to 24 hours per week. The working hours will be agreed upon separately.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and configure laptops, smartphones, and other IT equipment

• Install and configure software

• Troubleshoot hardware and software issues

• Provide IT support to employees

• Participate in various IT tasks and projects.

Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a relevant IT-related education

• Strong interest in computer hardware and software

• Serviceminded and eager to help others

• Able to work independently and in a structured manner

• Good communication skills in English (Danish is not a requirement).

We Offer

• Hands-on experience with IT in a professional organization

• Opportunities for learning, development, and responsibility

• Flexible working hours that can be adapted to your studies

• An informal and supportive work environment.

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will review applications on an ongoing basis so we urge you to submit your application and CV as soon as possible. The recruitment process will be closed once we have found the right candidate.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Jesper L. Christensen, IT Administrator, at +45 29 42 21 63

jobs.occupation: Marketing Automation & Paid Campaigns - Working Student
jobs.description:
Company Description

ViroGates is a NASDAQ First North-listed MedTech company headquartered in Birkerød, Denmark. We develop suPAR, a biomarker that reflects immune system activation and helps guide healthcare professionals.

Role Description

Our marketing team is growing. Alongside colleagues focused on content/social and UX/website design, we're looking for a third working student to take ownership of the technical and performance aspects of our marketing: keeping the website running and improving it, building out digital campaigns, and helping us reach healthcare professionals across Europe and beyond.

You'll work hands-on from day one, with room to test ideas and see the results.

What you'll do

Website

• 
Help maintain and update our WordPress site, in close cooperation with our UX/design student

• 
Implement tracking, landing pages, and forms

• 
Monitor performance in analytics and flag what's working and what isn't

• 
Support our SEO/AI scan to improve organic visibility

Email & automation

• 
Build and send newsletters and campaign emails

• 
Set up automated flows (welcome journeys, follow-ups, lead nurturing)

• 
Maintain lists and segmentation, and report on open, click, and conversion rates

Paid campaigns

• 
Set up and manage paid campaigns on relevant platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn, etc.)

• 
Support with audience targeting, ad variants, and budget monitoring

• 
Pull together simple performance reports and suggest optimizations

What you bring

• 
Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree program, ideally in marketing, communication, business, digital media, or something related - but we care more about interest than subject

• 
A good understanding of digital marketing tools and channels, especially relevant social media and paid advertising

• 
Structured and reliable - you'll own deadlines

• 
English speaker at a professional level

Nice to have, not required: experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, or WordPress; understanding of SEO; basic coding knowledge.

What we offer

• 
15-20 hours per week, with flexible hours to accommodate your studies and exams

• 
Free transportation ("pendlerkort") to our office in Birkerød at Banevænget 13, located right next to the train station

• 
A friendly, less hierarchical, and collaborative work environment where we are all working together with a common goal

• 
Option to gain practical experience in international marketing and communications in the MedTech sector

• 
Competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact in a growing company

How to apply

• 
If this sounds like the perfect fit for you, please apply by submitting your CV via LinkedIn. We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. For any questions, contact Alex Delatour, VP of Business Development, at ade@virogates.com.

**SENIOR CONSULTANT - VALIDATION

******Join Our Team at Devote Consulting

****Are you an experienced professional in GxP system validation? Devote Consulting is expanding, and we’re looking for a Senior Consultant to join our team. jobs.occupation: Product Manager – AI | Shape the Future of Construction Tech with Dalux
jobs.description:
**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will:

• Provide technical leadership in design, development, and testing.

• Define and own test architecture and quality strategy at team level.

• Balance active coding (C#, Angular, APL) with guiding automation initiatives

• Drive adoption of automation-first practices across the team.

• Ensure high-quality delivery by monitoring coverage, test metrics, and quality KPIs.

• Mentor and coach engineers in development, automation, and testing skills.

• Represent QA/Dev combined approach in cross-team forums.

• Collaborate with stakeholders (POs, TLs, architects) to align technical and quality goals.

• Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for complex defects and ensure preventive actions

• Advocate for and implement improvements in tools, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering processes.

• Continuously assessing and improving engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality

• Represent the team in technical forums and contribute to cross-team knowledge exchange.

**What We Value

**

• We are looking for an engineer who has demonstrated leadership abilities

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering with combined Dev/QA responsibilities.

• Expertise in .NET / C# and working knowledge of Angular.

• Known for impactful leadership, resulting in improved efficiency and project success among engineering teams

• Extensive background in test automation (E2E, API, Integration) and test strategy

• Solid experience in architecting and developing enterprise-scale applications.

• Extensive knowledge of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures (Microsoft Azure experience)

• Deep expertise in CI/CD pipelines and tools (Git, TeamCity, Azure DevOps).

• Thorough understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and Domain-Driven Design

• Familiarity with XP practices (TDD, pair programming, continuous integration).

• Experience with relational databases (SQL).

• Readiness to learn APL, developing new features and debugging existing functionality, with full support from our team throughout the learning process.

• Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), both written and spoken

• Ability to mentor, motivate, and guide a team toward technical excellence and efficient delivery

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms.

• Background in FinTech or capital markets.

• Knowledge and experience in the financial domain, fintech, derivatives (options, futures, swaps, etc.) is an advantage.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process.

To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.occupation: 800xA System Specialist to Life Science Automation
jobs.description:
Bei ABB unterstützen wir Industrien dabei, effizienter und sauberer zu arbeiten – und jede einzelne Person trägt hier dazu bei. Wir bieten allen Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und die eigene Entwicklung aktiv voranzutreiben. Gemeinsam entstehen Lösungen, auf die alle stolz sein können. Wir suchen engagierte Talente, um gemeinsam die Welt voranzutreiben.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

Do you have extensive experience with System 800xA and a strong background in troubleshooting complex process plants? Are you ready to take on a key specialist role where you define automation architecture and develop advanced technical solutions for our customers?

If so, this is your opportunity to make a significant technical impact within ABB’s Life Science business.

ABB delivers large-scale 800xA systems to leading Pharma and Life Science customers in Denmark. The success of these projects is driving a growing pipeline, and you will play a central role in shaping future opportunities. As a technical lead, you will contribute to development projects and work closely with our business development team on upcoming initiatives.

In this role, you will collaborate with ABB engineers, project managers, and service account managers across multiple customer projects in Life Science production environments. As a System 800xA specialist, you will take ownership of complex troubleshooting, guide architectural decisions, and identify optimal solutions.

With your deep expertise in System 800xA, automation architecture, and process control libraries, you will solve high-complexity challenges that others cannot – both for customers and their sub-suppliers.

You can be based in Ballerup, Kalundborg, or Middelfart. However, you should expect to be on-site with customers in Bagsværd and/or Kalundborg at least one day per week, with increased presence during critical project phases.

Your responsibilities

• Coordination with relevant internal ABB functions for resolution of complex technical issues for customers.

• Diagnose and troubleshoot on technical issues - evaluation of problem descriptions, analysis of log files, remote diagnostics in installed base, etc.

• Take the lead in maturing and developing architecture for new projects.

• Consult the customer with the right solutions based on technical knowledge and support from ABB organization.

• Develop, test, document and PoC in technical solutions and support your colleagues in executing.

Qualifications for the role

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in 800xA with AC800M process in larger size process automation projects.

• In depth experience with 800xA system and control libraries (e.g. PCDL, PCEL) from troubleshooting and development

• Solid experience with test, commissioning, and hypercare phases of an automation project, and familiar with typical issues raised during these phases.

• Experience from ABB R&D organization is an advantage.

• Experience within Life Science industries and batch management is an advantage.

• Ability to understand customer requirements and challenges with a service-minded approach.

• Experience in working either within or together with the L3 support team or L4 R&D.

• Demonstrating ownership, applying a problem-solving solution-oriented mindset and strong communication skills.

More about us

At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization with very good well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability.

When you join ABB, you become part of a global, world-leading technology company known for innovation, quality, and opportunity. In ABB’s Life Science organization, you will be part of a highly successful business with a strong brand, a clear strategy, and an exciting project pipeline for the coming years. Equally important, you will enjoy a positive work environment characterized by respect, helpfulness, and a supportive tone.

You will be part of our Life Science Engineering team, collaborating with experienced engineers. We are an international group of approx. 50 project engineers in Denmark. In addition, we collaborate with +50 colleagues from the global ABB organization.

You will have a fixed base in our office in Ballerup, Kalundborg or Middelfart, where most of your close colleagues are also based. We also offer the possibility of working from home a few days a week.

The position reports to Engineering Manager, Lars Schultz.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also save selected jobs. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Lars Schultz at +45 2497 8635. You can also find more information about us on our website www.abb.com.

The application deadline is 08.12.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable future with efficient use of resources. By connecting our knowledge in engineering and digitalization, ABB makes industry more efficient, productive, sustainable and able to improve their performance. At ABB, we call it 'Engineered to Outrun'. The company has over 140 years of history and more than 105,000 employees worldwide. In Denmark, you will have more than 500 colleagues in offices in Ballerup, Middelfart, Esbjerg, Kalundborg and Aalborg.

_Join us. Be part of the team where progress takes place, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

Run What Runs the World._

Die Zukunft wird sauberer und intelligenter durch vielfältige Talente – neugierige, mutige und kreative. Wir schätzen Menschen mit unterschiedlichem persönlichem Hintergrund und Erfahrungen.

Who are we?

Sanos is a full circle clinical research and development organization with headquarter in Søborg, near Copenhagen, Denmark. The organization consists of around 200 employees, and is composed of six independent business units, each contributing to the comprehensive clinical research services provided. These units include NBCD, Sanos Clinic, Sanos Supply, Studies&Me, Blueskin, and Omicron.

All business units in Sanos are dedicated to providing first-class clinical research, aiming to keep improving and develop how we conduct innovative clinical trials for our clients and patients. We play a critical role in developing new medication and treatment options, and work diligently to bring new medication faster to the patients.

Your key roles and responsibilities

The Site Contract Manager is responsible for negotiating and executing clinical trial agreements and site budgets for our global Phase 1–3 trials, ensuring timely site activation and appropriate contractual and financial terms.

• Lead the end-to-end negotiation and execution of Clinical Trial Agreements, amendments and site budgets.

• Act as the main contact for contractual and budget discussions with sites, institutions and sponsors.

• Drive contracts to signature within agreed timelines and escalate legal, operational or financial issues as needed.

• Maintain contract trackers and provide clear status updates to study teams and management.

• Coordinate with Clinical Operations, Clinical Proposals and Finance, including handover for site payment setup in Veeva.

• Support continuous improvement of contracting templates, processes and tools.

Travel: Little, if any, travel is expected.

Work location: Søborg, Denmark.

Desired skills and experience

• Hands-on site contracting experience from a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology or clinical research environment.

• Strong experience negotiating Clinical Trial Agreements and site budgets, preferably across multiple countries.

• Good understanding of study start-up and the link between contracting, site activation and study delivery.

• Ability to identify contractual, commercial and operational risks and escalate appropriately.

• Experience with trackers and reporting tools; knowledge of Veeva site payment setup is an advantage.

• Strong written and spoken English.

Success criteria includes

• Driving contract execution within agreed project timelines

• Support achieving First Site Activated as well as Last Site Activated

• Contribute to reduction of contracting cycles and cycle times, and ensure sustainable and compliant budget agreements.

Personal profile

• A confident and pragmatic negotiator with strong attention to detail.

• Structured and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple contracts and deadlines.

• Collaborative, commercially aware and comfortable working independently in an international environment

Job Description

Would you like to work with Cyber Security for Industrial Systems in a company that develops and maintains highly complex, mission critical systems for a global market? Then take this opportunity to create something that matters.

Join us to apply your expertise within Cyber Security of complex software products and projects for logistics centres and airports worldwide. Take on this exciting and demanding leadership challenge to help us deliver integrated Cyber Security for vital infrastructure solutions.

Join a software center of excellence

You join BEUMER Group to become responsible for our Cyber Security activities for our portfolio of technically complex software products and projects for automated baggage handling systems and parcel sorters. These mission critical systems are installed across international airports and logistics centers as a completely essential part of daily operations 24/7/365. We have the leading products on the market, and the office in Aarhus, Denmark, is an international center of excellence within the BEUMER organization.

Cyber Security for industrial systems

Specifically, you become responsible for monitoring and implementing best practices within Cyber Security for industrial systems. Focus is on Cyber Security for the systems that we deliver to our customers. We comply with internationally recognized standards and have a process-oriented approach as Cyber Security is part of all aspects of what we do.

You will have a close dialogue with both our software product organization and our software project organization and our project IT-Infrastructure team. You will quite naturally be working closely with our Software Process Improvement department, and you will report to the Global Software Director.

Leader of a specialist team

You will be leading a small team of highly professional cyber security specialists while at the same time driving cyber security across BEUMERs global software team in close collaboration with BEUEMRs CISO team. As such you will be in dialog with group companies and product and project departments coordinating cyber security initiatives and communicating Cyber Security strategy, roadmap and best practices.

Skilled in Cyber Security

As responsible for our Cyber Security activities, your task is to enable the organization to deliver Cyber Secure software products, projects and services needed for mission critical systems. To do so, we believe you:

• Have a relevant master’s degree related to software development and/or cyber security

• Experience in analyzing a software organization's cybersecurity priorities and practices

• You have at least 2 years’ of relevant experience in the cybersecurity field.

• Previous work experience with applying or using frameworks such as ISA/IEC 62443, EU CRA, NIS2 and ISO27001/2 in an international environment.

• Relevant security certifications (CISSP, CCSK etc.) are a plus

Other than that, we would also like you to:

• Be structured, factual and have well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills with practical ability to shape the Cybersecurity agenda.

• Thrive in a fast-paced international environment with many stakeholders

• Have a good understanding of technologies and methodologies within software development

• Possess solid leadership skills and strong in stakeholder management and communication knowing how to create buy-in and setting direction.

• Have knowledge about agile software development processes, CMMI and similar methods and standards would be an advantage.

• Be PMI, IPMA or Prince2 certified or similar training/certification would be a plus.

Some travel must be expected as we are an international organisation. Therefore we expect you to communicate fluently in English.

To lead our cyber security activities, you will in addition to the above need drive, energy, and good commutation and stakeholder management skills. You have the experience to facilitate improvement initiatives and implement changes in an organization.
